email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital & Social Media Consultant role focused on European climate and energy policy. With hands-on experience managing websites, SEO and content for clients in Belgium and abroad, I am drawn to this opportunity to apply my digital and editorial skills to a mission that matters.

In my current role at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and content for client sites, while also building and maintaining a WordPress site with ~600 member profiles. Previously, at Knowledge Experts, I supported website builds and ran SEO analyses, reporting on performance with Google Analytics and Search Console. I am comfortable coordinating inputs from multiple contributors, managing editorial calendars and turning technical topics into clear content. I also have experience with Canva and basic video production, and I am based in Zwijndrecht, within easy reach of Brussels.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to your client's communications team.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Digital & Social Media Consultant position focused on European climate and energy policy. Your description of a role that combines editorial planning, LinkedIn management, website publishing and creative production speaks directly to how I work: with a mix of digital judgment, hands-on production and a strong sense of what makes technical content land with an audience.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, keyword research and content for client websites, and I build and maintain a WordPress site for a pharmacists' association, including a consistent layout for around 600 member profile pages. This has given me practical experience in coordinating content across many contributors, keeping pages current and applying SEO good practice. Previously, at Knowledge Experts, I supported the team in building SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for large organisations and designed client websites in WordPress, from structure to content and social media integration. I also ran SEO analyses and reported on performance using Google Analytics and Google Search Console.

I have a technical background in computer science and front-end development, which helps me work confidently with CMS platforms, structured data and analytics. I use Canva for graphics and have experience recording and editing video content. I am based in Zwijndrecht, close to Brussels, and available during European working hours.

I would be glad to discuss how my skills can support your client's communications team.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
